selected_skill.name: blogwatcher
selected_skill.selection_reason: This skill matches a public feed-monitoring workflow, uses low-sensitivity inputs, and does not depend on private accounts or external workspace permissions.

design_goals: Keep the task as a monitoring and digest-construction task rather than a repair task.
Make with-skill and without-skill differ only through environment/skills and the corresponding runtime skill-copy behavior.
Force action-level work around feed discovery, cross-format scanning, duplicate handling, and article-level triage.

input_data.notes: Selected RSS entries derived from the GitHub Changelog feed.
Selected Atom-style mirror of the same public feed to create duplicate references across source aliases.
Selected GitHub Blog entries covering security, tutorials, and company updates.
Selected Python Insider entries covering releases, prereleases, and project updates.
Selected Node.js Blog entries covering LTS releases, event recaps, and security program updates.
Selected Docker Blog entries covering supply-chain security analysis and product-marketing posts.

task_shape.runtime: single container with an internal static HTTP service and optional skill-installed CLI
task_shape.solver_action: scan mirrored feeds, merge duplicate article references, classify the in-scope items, and deliver the digest outputs

intended_failures: Naive parsers miss Atom entries or relative links and leave out actionable items.
Naive digest builders skip article-level canonicalization and fail to merge duplicate references.
Naive classification logic keeps tutorials, event posts, and marketing material in the final digest.
Naive output generation omits skipped duplicate records or mislabels before-checkpoint items.
verifier_focus: Recompute the expected digest independently from the mirrored feeds and article pages.
Check that duplicate relevant references are merged by canonical URL while duplicate skip records are still present.
Check that publication-time filtering follows the checkpoint file rather than feed order alone.
Protect the input mirror files and skill definition from solver edits.
Require both the structured JSON digest and the markdown brief.
with_without_difference_policy: Only environment/skills/ and the corresponding runtime skill-copy logic may differ between with-skill and without-skill variants.
iteration_notes: Do not modify the selected skill.
Do not rewrite the task into a repair scenario.
without-skill failure should stay action-level, with at least one verifier miss outside trivial formatting drift.
README comparison metrics will be filled after completed task-level experiments.

notes: The oracle independently recomputes the digest from mirrored feeds and article pages.
The with-skill and without-skill variants use the same task, tests, data, dependencies, and instruction; only environment/skills presence differs.

final_experiments.counting_rule: Recent valid task-level runs with complete agent trajectories; startup-only failures were excluded.

with_skill_runs.artifact_note: Verifier reward, verifier output, and complete trajectory were present; Harbor summary result.json was not emitted for this run.

without_skill_runs.failure_summary: Misclassified one deprecation item priority and placed it in the wrong markdown priority section.
Skipped-item records were incomplete, leaving verifier-visible misses outside formatting drift.
